title: private-deployment-lyra-weekly-sync-2026-09-21
content:
Lyra Private Deployment — Weekly Sync (2026-09-21)
Owners: Priya Shah (SE), Ethan Kim (Infra), Maya Rodriguez (Customer Success)
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Maya, Samir (Lyra infra), Olivia (Lyra SRE)
Meeting length: 30m

Objective:
- Surface progress on VPC connectivity and on-prem install milestones, escalate blockers, confirm owners + ETA for open items.

Agenda:
1) Quick status round (5m)
2) Networking & firewall / VPC peering updates (8m)
3) On-prem installer / operator progress (8m)
4) Blockers & mitigation plan (5m)
5) Action items and next steps (4m)

Notes / Updates:
- Overall: On track for soft launch in customer staging by 2026-10-12, but two infra blockers could push timeframe if not resolved.

1) Status round:
- Priya: Coordinating rollout plan; preparing canary test matrix for Lyra feature set (chat + embeddings).
- Ethan: Core infra ready in Redwood staging; working with Lyra on VPC peering tests.
- Maya: Lyra security review underway; waiting on updated network diagrams from Lyra SRE.
- Samir (Lyra): Completed side A of peering setup; seeing intermittent route flaps when we cross AZ boundary.
- Olivia (Lyra SRE): Will provide firewall rules doc by EOD 2026-09-22.

2) Networking & VPC peering:
- Current state: Peering established but route flaps observed during cross-AZ traffic. Hypothesis: asymmetric routing due to transit gateway config on Lyra side.
- Action: Ethan to review Lyra TGW routing tables and provide recommended config changes.
- ETA: initial findings by 2026-09-23.
- Contingency: If TGW fix not possible quickly, propose temporary static route via dedicated NAT instance (costly) to stabilize connectivity for staging tests.

3) On-prem installer / operator:
- Installer progress: initial operator image built and tested on Redwood QA (small cluster). Helm chart updated to v0.9.
- Postgres persistence issue: on-prem test showed slow WAL shipping under load; likely tuning needed for fsync and checkpoint settings.
- Action: Samir to run installer on Lyra's 3-node lab cluster this week; report perf metrics by 2026-09-24.
- Action: Priya to escalate PostgreSQL tuning recommendations doc to Lyra DB team (link in linked_artifacts).

4) Blockers & risks:
- Blocker A (High): Route flaps causing intermittent API failures during peering tests. Owner: Ethan + Lyra SRE. Mitigation: TGW routing audit; fallback NAT path.
- Blocker B (Medium): Postgres WAL lag under load in on-prem tests. Owner: Priya + Samir. Mitigation: tuning parameters, test on Lyra lab cluster, consider moving to managed DB in initial staging if unresolved.
- Blocker C (Low): Missing CIS scan evidence for the operator image (Lyra security asked for signed SBOM). Owner: Maya. Mitigation: produce SBOM and sign image; ETA 2026-09-28.

5) Decisions made:
- Proceed with staging canary schedule (internal testing) while network team investigates peering flaps; if flaps persist, pause external load tests until NAT fallback implemented.
- Continue with operator build (v0.9) but gate production rollout on DB tuning results.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ethan Kim — Review Lyra TGW routing tables + deliver recommended config + list of required firewall rules (2026-09-23).
- Samir Patel (Lyra) — Run installer on 3-node lab cluster, capture WAL/DB perf metrics, and share logs (2026-09-24).
- Priya Shah — Postgres tuning recommendation doc + send to Lyra DB team; include quick mitigations if WAL lag persists (2026-09-23).
- Maya Rodriguez — Produce SBOM and sign operator image, upload to shared S3 bucket and notify Lyra security (2026-09-28).
- Olivia Chen (Lyra) — Share final firewall rules & network diagram (EOD 2026-09-22).
- Priya/Ethan — Prepare canary test matrix and smoke test checklist for staging (2026-09-25).

Follow-ups for next sync (2026-09-28 tentative):
- Status on TGW routing fixes and whether NAT fallback required.
- Postgres perf results from lab cluster and decision on DB approach for staging.
- SBOM/signature confirmation and security acceptance steps.
- Confirm canary test schedule and responsible observers for each test.

Notes to self / loose items:
- Confirm whether Lyra will allow us to deploy managed DB for first-phase tests (cost trade-offs).
- Keep record of cross-AZ metrics: packet loss, latency, route change count — ask Lyra SRE to include these in logs.
- Follow up on SOC/compliance checklist items after SBOM produced.

Attachments / refs:
- CONFLUENCE-LYRA-PRIVATE-DEPLOY (deployment runbook)
- JIRA-LYRA-1287 (Networking: peering & TGW ticket)
- github.com/redwood/lyra-deploy/pull/58 (installer: helm chart changes)

Next meeting: 2026-09-28 at 10:00 PT (send calendar invite once ETA from Ethan confirmed).

Prepared by: Priya Shah — notes are working draft, will update after TGW review results are in.
